0.description: Extrapolation using R²-weighted power law and exponential fits to estimate log10(median steps) at N=2000

1.description: Predict log10 expected steps at N=2000 incl. scaling+reliability

2.description: Log10 expected steps@2000 with reliability-adjusted cost + coverage

3.description: AIC-mixed scaling to predict log10 steps@2000 with smooth fail/coverage

4.description: Predict log10 steps@2000 with smooth reliability & cap penalties

5.description: log10 expected steps@2000 with scaling+reliability-margin penalties

6.description: Predict log10 expected steps at N=2000 incl. success-rate + scaling

7.description: Censor-aware AIC model avg scaling to N=2000 w/ failure lower-bounds

8.description: Predict log10 expected steps at N=2000 with success+scaling+coverage

9.description: AIC-avg log10 expected solve-steps at N=2000 incl. success+coverage

10.description: AIC-avg robust scaling to log10 expected steps@2000 + reliability

12.description: AIC-avg log10 expected restart-steps@2000 + slope & reliability

13.description: Predict log10(p-adjusted steps@2000) with smooth coverage & slope penalties

14.description: Predict log10 restart-steps@2000 with reliability margin & censoring

15.description: AIC-weighted censored scaling fit of restart-steps to N=2000

16.description: Minimize extrapolated log-steps at a larger reference N while penalizing near-threshold failure rates and step-budget saturation, with a reward for reaching larger N.

17.description: Minimize a composite score: (i) maximize effective solved size Neff at unsolved≤0.4 (hard+soft), (ii) penalize above-threshold unsolved smoothly (N-weighted, uncertainty-aware), and (iii) minimize scaling via log‑TTS and fitted log(step)~p log(N) slope.

18.description: Composite score prioritizing robust high-N solves (u<=0.3/0.2), while tie-breaking by weighted unsolved/step-efficiency, penalizing brittleness near 0.5, and favoring low scaling exponent at top-N.

19.description: Soft-pass area (u≈0.5) + top-level reward + success-only scaling penalty, with strong anti-truncation (few levels / small largest N) so timeouts can’t look good.

20.description: Reach-maximization (hard fail if break before 640 and, when medium/high present, before 1280) with tie-break log10(median_step) at max successful N plus tail log-log slope+slack penalties over top successful Ns

21.description: Maximize largest successful N (reach) with smooth tie-breakers: budget-margin/slack on last successes, conservative predicted next-N clearance margin, and tail curvature penalty from log-step scaling on successful prefix only.

22.description: Minimize (-log2 clearance N*) + weighted near-budget tail penalty, using only the successful prefix (unsolved_fraction<0.5) to favor headroom to 1280+ without penalizing unsolved_fraction≈0.49.

23.description: Maximize reachable N while conservatively (worst-of-multi-fit) minimizing predicted median_step/schedule_budget clearance at N=1280(+2560) and penalizing near-budget tail slack and worsening log-log trends.

24.description: Reach-dominant score using only successful-prefix data: maximize largest successful N plus conservative (worst-of w∈{2,3,5}) predicted earliest scheduled N where median_step/max_steps exceeds 0.7, with added penalty for last-step ratio “budget cliff” jumps.

25.description: Reach proxy: maximize robust scheduled N* with worst-window predicted median_step/max_steps ≤0.60 (ratio-space clearance), plus tail-hazard penalties for sudden end-of-prefix scaling accelerations.

26.description: Gated (N_max≥453) tail-only headroom-to-1280 score: last-step ratio + worst-window predicted ratios at 905/1280 (safety≈0.68) plus tail slope/curvature penalties; otherwise smooth large penalty.

27.description: Tail-local polynomial scaling and budget-clearance robustness using only the successful prefix: penalize local log-log step exponents >2 and positive acceleration, plus low/unstable log(max_steps/median_step) margins near the tail.

28.description: Gated two-jump headroom at the 640→905→1280 schedule: from last 2–3 successes estimate local exponent k and penalize k>2 plus predicted median/max_steps overshoot (>0.65) at 905 & 1280, with extra penalty if any failure (unsolved_fraction≥0.5) exists.

29.description: Composite proxy prioritizing (i) largest N ever solved (unsolved_fraction<0.5), then (ii) low scaling exponent on successful Ns only, plus (iii) a censored step-extrapolation to N=2000 consistent with the first truly failed level.

30.description: Composite reach+scaling score with secondary headroom-on-success and frontier-robustness terms around the unsolved_fraction=0.5 threshold (no penalty for 0.49).

31.description: Schedule-faithful lexicographic score: (1) maximize max_solved_N, then (2) minimize log10(best median_step) at max_solved_N, then (3) minimize robust log-log slope on successful points, plus (4) censor penalty from first true fail (N_fail,max_steps_fail); also exposes an area-under-passed-levels helper.

32.description: Successful-prefix tail headroom score: minimize conservative (worst-window) predicted median_step/max_steps overshoot for the next 1–2 scheduled N jumps, plus tail slope and explicit budget-cliff penalties, with one censor constraint from the first true failure.

33.description: Schedule-faithful lexicographic reach (max cleared N) with strong tail headroom tie-break (median/max_steps over last 2–4 successes), budget-cliff penalty, and conservative worst-window next-N clearance in log-ratio space (esp. 1280→1810→2560).

34.description: Reach-dominant, schedule-faithful score: maximize cleared scheduled N (uf<0.5 only), tie-break by tail median_step/max_steps headroom, conservative worst-window next-N (esp. 1810/2560) budget-overshoot, and tail budget-cliff; optional single censor-consistency from first uf>=0.5.

35.description: Reach-dominant, schedule-faithful score using only uf<0.5 (success) with tail-heavy median_step/schedule_budget headroom, conservative worst-window predictions at 1810/2560, explicit budget-cliff hazard, and one censor-consistency check from first uf>=0.5.

36.description: Reach-dominant, schedule-faithful proxy: maximize cleared scheduled N (uf<0.5 only), then minimize a smooth-max of median_step/schedule_budget over last-3 clears plus conservative worst-window predictions for next-2 Ns (esp. 1810/2560), with explicit budget-cliff hazard (905→1280→1810) and repeat-run stability penalties (pass/fail + headroom only).

37.description: Schedule-faithful reach (max cleared scheduled N; pass iff unsolved_fraction<0.5) with smooth-max tie-break minimizing median_step/schedule_budget headroom on last-3 clears + conservative next-2-N predictions (focus 1280→1810→2560), plus tail hazard (905→1280→1810) and tiny repeat-stability penalty.

38.description: Schedule-faithful reach (uf<0.5 only) with tie-break minimizing smooth-max headroom ratio median_step/schedule_budget over last-3 cleared + conservative worst-window prediction at N=2560, plus tail-local exponent(k>2) and post-1280 budget-cliff hazard; failures used only for one censor lower-bound check.

39.description: Schedule-faithful reach (-max cleared scheduled N; pass iff uf<0.5) with tie-break minimizing smooth-max log(median_step/schedule_budget) over last-3 clears + conservative worst-window preds@2560 (+@1810 if not cleared), plus explicit budget-cliff hazard penalties on log-ratio jumps 905→1280→1810 and 1810→2560 (predicted if unobserved).

40.description: Schedule-faithful reach (max cleared scheduled N via uf<0.5 only) with tie-breaks: smooth-max log(headroom)=log(median_step/schedule_budget) on last clears + conservative preds@1810/2560, explicit budget-cliff hazard (905→1280→1810→2560), and optional repeat-robustness.

41.description: Schedule-faithful reach (-max cleared scheduled N; pass iff uf<0.5) with tie-break smooth-max log(median_step/schedule_budget) on last-3 clears + conservative preds@{1810,2560}, plus gated multi-jump hazard (905→1280→1810→2560) and optional repeat-robustness/censor-check.
